notes: Corrected: בְּתוֹכָהּ → *were in it* now fuses בְּ+תוֹךְ to *were in* under rule 30 (headed on תָּוֶךְ), with the copula joining that unit under rule 49, replacing the accepted split that left תָּוֶךְ `unrepresented`.
Variant WLC.EZK.14.20.v003 is underdetermined and the projection carries the r00-base reading of דָּנִיֵּאל (s003), which the ASV's *Daniel* permits; no rule 53 case arises.
Unlike EZK.14.16, no waw stands between the two אִם clauses here, so the second אִם itself carries the closing *nor*.
The restrictive *but* of *should but deliver* is `added`: that clause writes no conjunction.
